subject: Wrap-chain index + operator attestation for Asteria onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Torres <security@asteria.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: devops+audit@asteria.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: wrap-chain index + operator attestation for SOC2/SIG

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of the SOC 2 and SIG intake for Asteria Financial we need a compact deliverable that demonstrates key custody/rewrap practices for tenant-byok and ephemeral wrapping. Specifically we'd like:

- A concise "wrap-chain index" (CSV or table) showing key wrapping relationships, wrap algorithms, and the timeline of rotations for the last 12 months.
- A short operator attestation (signed PDF) describing the HSM operator process for ceremony/rewraps and separation-of-duty controls.
- Two sample rewrap logs (anonymized): one from an emergency rewrap and one from a scheduled rotation.

Can you confirm whether you can provide those artifacts by EOD Tue (2027-06-22)? Also, we'll need a 20–30 minute operator interview for our SIG windmill on Jul 1 (UTC-4). Please propose names and availability for the interviews.

Deliverables can be uploaded to the Drive folder we created (link below). If any of this requires redaction checks, flag it and we can handle via secure upload.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Senior Security Assurance Manager | Asteria Financial
security@asteria.com

--
Attachment stubs: 1) requirements_checklist.txt
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AsteriaOnboardEvidence

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <security@asteria.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: wrap-chain index + operator attestation for SOC2/SIG

Elena — thanks for the clear checklist. We'll own this delivery from the Redwood side. Plan below:

- Marissa will assemble the wrap-chain index (CSV) and export a brief timeline.
- Ben will prepare the operator attestation draft and coordinate signatures with the on-call HSM operator.
- I'll prepare anonymized redacted rewrap logs and confirm retention windows.

Target: deliver all three artifacts to your Drive folder by Tue EOD (2027-06-22). We can do the operator interview Jul 1 — Ben and the operator (A. Nguyen) are tentatively available between 14:00–16:00 UTC-4.

Open items for you: please confirm whether you need the CSV to include cipher-suite and key-id hashing (we can provide full key IDs in a sealed transcript if required) and whether the sample logs should include shift-level operator IDs or be fully anonymized.

I'll attach a first-pass index and the draft attestation in a follow-up once Marissa/Bens finish.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

--
Attachment stubs: none (will follow)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Elena Torres <security@asteria.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: wrap-chain index + operator attestation for SOC2/SIG

Quick status update — attaching the initial wrap-chain index and a compact timeline. Notes inside the CSV for fields we redacted.

Highlights:
- wrapchain_timeline_v1.csv: includes columns (wrap_id, wrapped_key_type, source_key_kek_hash, wrapper_version, wrap_algo, rotation_date_utc, rewrap_reason)
- We hashed full key IDs with SHA256 and left the operator column as a role (operator_shift_1) to preserve PII. If you need cleartext key identifiers we can provide them under NDAs / sealed transcript.

Ben is drafting the operator statement (keystore-operator-statement-draft.pdf). It calls out dual-control ceremonies, HSM tamper-evidence checks, and the emergency rewrap playbook.

Sample logs: we are preparing a scheduled rotation log and a scrubbed emergency rewrap log. Two items to confirm from Asteria:
  1) Do you want the full syscall-level traces or just the HSM audit events?
  2) For emergency logs, do you need the operator's session-id mapping? We can mask to session-role only.

I uploaded the CSV draft and a short README to the Drive folder (link below). More to follow by EOD Tue.

Marissa Cole
Security Integrations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: wrapchain_timeline_v1.csv, README-wrapindex.md
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AsteriaOnboardEvidence

From: Elena Torres <security@asteria.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: devops+audit@asteria.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: wrap-chain index + operator attestation for SOC2/SIG

Thanks — this looks good as an initial pass. A few clarifications so we can scope our SIG review: 

- For the wrap-chain CSV, keep the hashed key IDs but add a separate column with a stable pseudonym (eg: K1, K2) so we can reference items in the interview without revealing hashed values.
- For logs: we need the HSM audit events (timestamp, event_type, operator_role, event_id) plus a single anonymized syscall sample for context — no full traces. Emergency logs should include the ticket/reference id and redacted operator session handle.
- Operator attestation: a signed PDF from the on-call operator describing the ceremony steps is preferred. If Ben can circulate a quick template, we'll sign it and return the signed copy.

Interview: Jul 1 at 15:00 UTC-4 works for Elena + 2 from our audit team. Please confirm Ben and A. Nguyen. If A. Nguyen prefers not to be on camera we can do audio-only.

If you can push the CSV + one sample log and the attestation draft into the Drive folder by Tue noon (2027-06-22 12:00 UTC-4), that'll let us pre-read before the interview.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Elena
Senior Security Assurance Manager | Asteria Financial
security@asteria.com
